text:
Did you hear about how Trump has started mailing out so-called ACA Refund Checks? After driving up health care costs, this is a slap in the face to all of us. And the timing… well the timing speaks for itself.

Here’s what you need to know:

First, Trump and his Rubber Stamp Republicans in Washington let ACA tax credits expire last year, driving up health care costs for millions of Americans. Health care premiums jumped by over $700 per year, per person, with families often seeing annual premium increases in the thousands.

As a result, over 2 million people have lost ACA coverage, unable to afford higher prices. In Ohio, we had the largest coverage drop, by percentage, in the country, with over 100,000 people losing coverage.

What’s worse? House Democrats forced a vote to extend these credits, which passed, but the President blocked the extension.

Now, just weeks before an election, Trump is mailing out $500 checks with a propaganda letter littered with lies. He claims these are rebates from excess fees.

But everyone is receiving the same “rebate” amount. How did they pick who got rebates? Well according to Reuters, 71% of these checks are going to just 13 states, and most of them are now states with the most competitive races, including Ohio.
